purpose: Convert exact v51 and predecessor evidence into route-level retain, repair, retire, and defer dispositions before any successor profile is proposed for live authority.

problem_restatement.observed_failure: The 500-dollar canary was followed by a 5000-dollar profile that increased per-position notional about 66.7x while several deployed route identities lacked compatible positive forward evidence.
problem_restatement.decision_error: Execution feasibility, telemetry completeness, and sparse favorable observations were treated too much like profitability qualification.
problem_restatement.asset_removal_interpretation: Removing SNDK and BRENTOIL was supported by weak autonomous economics. The error was narrowing the roster without qualified replacements and concentrating substantially larger exposure in the remaining routes.
problem_restatement.falsifier: An independently reconciled configuration or lifecycle archive showing comparable canary exposure and compatible positive forward evidence for every v51 route would overturn this diagnosis. Current frozen evidence shows neither.

active_v51_outcome.interpretation: Costs amplified the loss, but gross market PnL was already negative. This is a strategy and promotion-contract problem, not only a friction problem.

route_dispositions.reason: The positive validation and one later winner are contradicted by a negative pseudo-holdout. The route remains plausible but repeatability at the v51 contract is not established.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Collect exact v51-compatible entries and resolved fills under the frozen structural-stop and 3R contract; compare realized costs and side occupancy to the replay.
route_dispositions.confidence: medium on mechanism plausibility; low on current live expectancy
route_dispositions.falsifier: Several compatible forward closes remain positive after costs and largest-winner removal, including a nonpositive outcome sample; that would support a stronger retain disposition.

route_dispositions.reason: The 60-bps target beat the tested grid on six development signals and one later event, but this is too sparse to support a full-size profitability claim and carries parameter-selection risk.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Freeze the current 60/60 identity and collect exact v51 live-source entries without retuning the target grid.
route_dispositions.confidence: medium on implementation; low-medium on edge
route_dispositions.falsifier: A larger predeclared compatible forward window remains positive after exact fees, slippage, funding, and largest-winner removal.

route_dispositions.reason: The only exact v51 ETH lifecycle never developed favorable movement beyond its cost hurdle and closed negative. Earlier rare-winner evidence did not translate into compatible forward proof.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Do not reopen Range Onset. Search a distinct ETH mechanism with new signal identity and predeclared development/forward partitions.
route_dispositions.confidence: high for successor retirement; low on whether ETH lacks other viable mechanisms
route_dispositions.falsifier: New independent evidence from the unchanged Range identity becomes robust by side and after largest-winner removal. No such evidence is currently present.

route_dispositions.reason: The entry mechanism remains unproven and tested exit repairs were side-dependent or harmful. The current protected lifecycle is evidence collection, not a reason to retain the route.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Allow only the already-open protected control to resolve; do not create another Range Onset entry in a successor.
route_dispositions.confidence: high for no tested profit-lock repair; medium-high for retirement
route_dispositions.falsifier: A distinct predeclared SOL route, not a post-hoc Range parameter variation, produces robust compatible evidence.

route_dispositions.reason: Alignment is the strongest identified entry-quality discriminator, but it is post-development and only one prospective aligned short has resolved. Generic profit locks were harmful and the 100/25 floor has no independent trigger.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Replay a separately versioned alignment-only route with the exact native exit, then fill the missing prospective side/relation cells without retuning.
route_dispositions.confidence: medium for historical alignment separation; low for deployable edge
route_dispositions.falsifier: Aligned prospective outcomes become nonpositive after costs or largest-winner removal, or opposed outcomes become comparably robust.

route_dispositions.reason: One small profitable short proves lifecycle operation, not bidirectional expectancy. The entire result is one winner.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Collect exact source-native long and additional short lifecycles with v51 fee, profit-lock, stop, and mark-path attribution.
route_dispositions.confidence: high on technical lifecycle reconciliation; low on edge
route_dispositions.falsifier: A predeclared multi-lifecycle both-side window remains positive after exact costs and largest-winner removal.

route_dispositions.reason: The short sample is negative and largest-winner dependent, while the first long remains unresolved. Existing evidence does not justify another full-size entry.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Resolve the protected long and complete source-native pressure attribution before considering a separate pressure-aligned challenger.
route_dispositions.confidence: high on current negative resolved economics; low on durable both-side expectancy
route_dispositions.falsifier: Additional exact long and short lifecycles establish positive robust economics under the frozen route.

route_dispositions.reason: Venue liquidity is proven, but the distinct mechanism fails conservative stress and has produced no prospective onset. The retired BRENTOIL routes remain rejected.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Continue the isolated 5-minute observer until a fully attributable mechanism-specific lifecycle occurs; do not restore the retired strategies.
route_dispositions.confidence: high on liquidity; low on edge
route_dispositions.falsifier: Resolved prospective both-side lifecycles become positive under exact costs, stress, and largest-winner sensitivity.

route_dispositions.reason: MU has prospective data but remains sparse, one-sided, censored, and winner-dependent. It cannot fill a live slot yet.
route_dispositions.highest_value_next_test: Continue exact mark/book capture until short-side and independently resolved paths exist.
route_dispositions.confidence: high on evidence insufficiency; low on eventual edge
route_dispositions.falsifier: Both-side resolved prospective evidence becomes robust after costs, stress, and largest-winner removal.

portfolio_conclusion.interpretation: No current mechanism has evidence strong enough to justify the v51 default of 10 percent margin at 10x leverage. A successor needs staged evidence-bound sizing rather than equal full-size allocation.

approval_ready_containment_proposal.Recommendation: Activate the exact v51 transition drain; preserve current SOL and SPCX stops and exits; do not permit new entries while the successor is constructed.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Why now: Compatible closed economics are negative and no active route currently supports full-size continuation.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Exact v51 compatible lifecycle accounting, route-specific forward artifacts, current protected positions, historical and prospective challenger evidence, costs, outlier sensitivity, and technical path completeness.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: The current profile concentrates 5000-dollar notional per entry in unqualified mechanisms; containment prevents another unsupported entry while preserving auditable exits.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Applicable market regime: All regimes; this is a promotion-contract containment action.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Proposed live change: One exact-profile transition-drain command. No in-place strategy, stop, leverage, sizing, or exit mutation.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Expected upside: Prevent additional exposure from inadequately proven routes while retaining venue stops and bound exits for existing positions.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Main risks and failure modes: Current positions can still lose to their stops; valid opportunities can be missed; identity mismatch can reject the drain command.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Validation completed: Profile and run identity, backend health, open-position protection, compatible performance, and route evidence reconciliation.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Validation still required: Fresh command-time identity, acknowledged drain state, no later entry, managed existing exits, and final flat/order-free archive.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Success metrics: Zero new positions after activation, intact owned stops, exact existing exits, and a completed flat transition.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Failure / rollback triggers: Abort on stale or mismatched identity, missing protection, rejected command, or any new entry after acknowledgement. Do not restore authority without a separate approved successor.
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Confidence level: high on containment; medium on route retirement; low on successor profitability until new evidence resolves
approval_ready_containment_proposal.Explicit approval requested: Approve activation of the exact v51 transition drain.

limitations: Six compatible closes are too sparse to estimate durable route expectancy.
Several historical artifacts use different portfolio sizes, leverage, or source contracts; their normalized route behavior is evidence, not exact v51 portfolio PnL.
Current SOL and SPCX outcomes remain open and can change route diagnosis.
No candidate is promoted by this report and no parameter selection is performed.
The absence of a qualified route is not evidence that no profitable strategy exists; it means current evidence does not identify one reliably.
